title: selectBytes column-name token pre-encoding
impact: Native-side encoder amortization for `Database.selectBytes()`. `write_json_to_buf` in `native/resqlite.c` now pre-builds each column's `"col":` / `,"col":` token once at first-row time into a per-query scratch buffer, then emits each column on subsequent rows with a single `buf_write` instead of comma + `json_write_string` (SWAR scan + escape walk) + colon — collapsing four `buf_write*` calls per column per row into one on the common ASCII identifier case. Focused `select_bytes_wide_cols.dart` measures **−4% to −11%** across two order-flipped passes on 10k-row × 8 / 20-col shapes, with the 1-row and 100-row regression guards staying inside the sub-µs noise floor; `large_bytes_transfer.dart` (exp 174's focused guard) also moves **−8.7% / −8.2%** on large/small lanes. No public API change; behavior preserved by reusing `json_write_string` for the token build so escape semantics are identical.
